unanswered_points.point: Shared-anchor overlap: FLYW, AJG, KDP carry the same seat set on the same two fields; each seat was asked what its own method saw that the others did not. Uncontested, so never floored; no seat answered.
Lane PULLBACK vs fresh high and BULLISH_BOS (also FLYW): which pullback is meant? No seat answered; the slate prints elder-lens's pullback-to-ma_20 entry beside six break triggers.

Regime: seats themselves write 'tape RISK OFF' / 'market DOWNTREND', and oneil's market gate is DELEGATED, yet no case says why its long is valid in that tape and the slate prints no market line on 11 ADVANCE tickets.
Crowding: read the slate as one environment exposure. Only seow and oneil (TAK) touched it; the slate carries Healthcare 3 (ABBV, PFE, TAK), Financials 3 (AJG, MA, held V), Staples 2 (KDP, EL).
C23: if MA is taken alongside held V, which is the weaker to force out? seow passed it to the PM; no seat compared MA and V on fields.
Held-name TIGHTEN line (first single-bar drop in elder_5d, now 9,9); seow states a TIGHTEN too (red bar at the pivot, exit under its low). Raised at ratification; no seat or ticket took it up.

qa.note: Every seat read fields; none recited. But 151 messages moved no stance, and 105 ratification answers carry 0 objections and 30 reservations. Several reservations are disagreements filed softly: minervini and wyckoff call the MA and TTEK ADVANCE trigger a chase; oneil says TTEK is not at a high and MA is a late buy; raschke calls SN's break a chase; elder-lens's entry is dropped on ABBV, ECL, SN, CNQ; two seats' TIGHTEN line on held V is missing. Each trigger line lists every seat's own words, so each seat finds itself in it: that is breadth, not convergence. The ADVANCE/WATCH rule turns on whether oneil sits in the denominator (3 of 7 = ADVANCE, 3 of 6 = WATCH). Seats name a RISK OFF / DOWNTREND tape in their own againsts; the slate does not.
